limitations: L4 means offline synthetic software acceptance only, never laboratory, biological or clinical validation, adequacy or benefit. These fixtures are not outcome observations.

Normal closed forms ignore small-sample error, dependence and variance estimation. Binary nuisance is fixed under the supplied effect; MDE uses the sizing approximation rather than exact two-tail inversion.
Paths, hashes and timestamps cannot establish historical freezing, source authenticity or actual independence. Coordinator-owned rigor and independent review remain unavailable.

Conservative English case-insensitive whole-word prefix families: caus*, mechanis*, therap*, clinic*, efficac*, effective*, treat*, cure*, prevent*, recommend*, prescri*, bind*, affinit*, inhibit*, activat*, regulat*, drive/drives/driv*, induc*. Additional refusals: adequate, well powered, no effect, truth, physical validity, observed power and post hoc power (space/hyphen variants). Negations are included; other languages and paraphrases are incompletely covered.
Computed records and review approval cannot support positive claims; any unavailable citation forces unavailable status. Replicated status is always refused.

Inputs are bounded to 64 MiB per artifact, 256 MiB across unique inodes and 4,000,000 JSON values before parsing. End-of-run hash and ancestor checks detect changes but do not create a transactional snapshot.
